python - <<'PY'
import sys,json,numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/output'); from gen import Controller,fk
c=Controller(); q0=c.q.copy(); data=[]
def record():
 data.append({'q':c.q.tolist(),'eef':c.eef.tolist(),'cam':c.obs.meta['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl']})
record()
for j,delta in [(0,.12),(1,.12),(3,.12),(5,.18),(6,.18)]:
 q=q0.copy(); q[j]+=delta; c.moveq(q,1.2,note=f'cal_joint{j+1}'); record()
c.moveq(q0,1.2,note='cal_return'); record()
json.dump(data,open('/app/output/cal_data.json','w'),indent=2)
R=np.diag([-1.,-1.,1.]); A=[]; b=[]
for row in data:
 T=fk(row['q']); A.append(np.column_stack((np.eye(3),R@T[:3,:3]))); b.append(np.array(row['eef'])-R@T[:3,3])
x=np.linalg.lstsq(np.vstack(A),np.concatenate(b),rcond=None)[0]; print('FIT',x,'errors',np.vstack(A)@x-np.concatenate(b))
cal={'R':R.tolist(),'t':x[:3].tolist(),'tool':x[3:].tolist()}; json.dump(cal,open('/app/output/calibration.json','w'),indent=2)
PY
